enchantments.tooltip: Anthem: When equipped by a character with Bard levels, this item begins to hum an inspiring tune. Your bard songs regenerate slowly over time.
Charisma +13: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Devotion +72: Passive: +72 Insight bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.

Melody: Imperial Resonance: This powerful item is attuned to your ability to perform musical magic. If you have 15 or more bonus effective Bard levels from Feats, additional Bard songs, or enhancements, it provides 30 Exceptional Sonic Spell Power and 15% Exceptional Sonic Spell Lore.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
